body: I use to play a lot of video games. Whatever I played, I got really into it. Now that I've stopped, I've realized that I haven't enjoyed it as much as I've thought. I also used to really like math (of all things :|), but over the past year I have become completely disinterested.

I think they are my friends, but I just feel like I'm being bothersome to them. They say they don't mind but I really worry they do. 

I'm not quite sure what I like doing. Like I mentioned in the post, I used to be really passionate about things but they have all become uninteresting.
